checks: Review A remains selected after a delayed recovery response for last attempt B; cancellation targets A.
Editing the form while B recovery is in flight keeps an empty result and the edited amount.
A failed review of A clears the previous B receipt, then later recovery restores only selected A.
A lost evaluate response recovers the selected pending request, clears unknown state, and shows its receipt.
A pending unknown B settles while A is reviewed without replacing the A modal or leaving retry state behind.
Switching from a completed normal preset to a different scam preset preserves selection and accepts modal cancellation.
scope: Actual Next.js React UI with a preflight-verified synthetic in-process demo API; selected GET responses delayed and POST responses dropped.
